overview.title: The commercial heart of Safi
overview.p1: Safi's souks and market offer fresh produce, spices and pottery. The atmosphere is local and lively, especially in the morning.
overview.p2: A good complement to the potters' quarter and medina.
overview.p3: Combine with the port for a full morning.
